body.text:
We're working to end the trafficking and exploitation of children. That means showing up before harm happens, and walking alongside young people as they heal, at their pace, for as long as it takes. Because the goal isn’t just raising kids who are resilient to exploitation....it’s building a world where they don’t have to be.

// The Burden of Being Resilient: 🎤original poetry by Alysia Nicole Harris and 🎶original music by Tina Colón Williams

about.text: Working to improve the lives of the 350+ million people navigating rare and complex conditions

body.text:
My son has Angelman Syndrome, and lately we’ve been struggling with his seizures. ❤️

I was recently given the opportunity to try Ari, an AI system created to support people and caregivers living with rare diseases. It can help track seizures, medications and symptoms, remind you when it may be time to contact your doctor, and even help you organize messages for your medical team.

After just a few minutes talking with Ari during a really difficult time, I had information that helped me recognize what was happening and reach out to my son’s doctors. It truly made a difference for me.

Ari is FREE right now while it’s in beta testing for people living with rare diseases and their caregivers. I have a link in my bio if you want to check it out. ❤️

#AngelmanSyndrome #RareDisease #RareDiseaseCaregiver #SeizureAwareness #CaregiverSupport @nashafitter @citizen.health
